title: Keeping a candidate twice changes nothing
description:
As a curator (or an agent retrying), I want judging to be idempotent.

```gherkin
Feature: Judging candidates
  Scenario: Keeping a candidate twice changes nothing
    Given a loop candidate from "Thunderer"
    When I keep it with 4 stars in crate "digs"
    And I keep it again with 4 stars in crate "digs"
    Then there is exactly one curated slice, one verdict and one crate item for it
```
